summary.text: John "Drew" Williams is a lifelong resident of Marshall County, Kentucky, and a Murray State University history graduate who has worked in the family dock-building trade. Running as the Democratic nominee for Kentucky's 1st District, he says he wants to bring more public engagement, such as town halls and issue-driven debates, into how he would represent the district.

paragraphs.text: Williams describes himself as a lifelong resident of Marshall County, Kentucky. Ballotpedia says he was born in Paducah.
He graduated from Murray State University in 2016 with a degree in History and a minor in Biology.

By his own account, Williams has spent nearly two decades working in family-owned businesses building docks and marinas across five states. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as construction work.
He says that since 2019 he and his wife have worked with the community to revitalize the Tater Day festival, and that he has volunteered locally.
